title: claude-auth config
description: Configuration of the claude-auth command, which signs in to a Claude account (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise), refreshes its tokens and reports the state of the credential file the Anthropic adapter reads (upstream.credential_file). Every key is optional; the defaults are shown. The sign-in endpoints and the client id are not documented by Anthropic: the defaults are the ones Claude Code uses, found in the source of the pi coding agent and in the Claude Code binary, so each is a key. Anthropic's terms limit subscription credentials to its own applications; using them here is the account owner's decision.

auth_file.description: Credential file this command writes and the adapter reads. Absolute, or starting with ~/.

authorize_url.description: Full URL of the authorization page, without query or fragment.

token_url.description: Full URL of the token endpoint (JSON body), without query or fragment.

client_id.description: OAuth client id. This is Claude Code's public client id.

scope.default: org:create_api_key user:profile user:inference user:sessions:claude_code user:mcp_servers user:file_upload

authorize_params.description: Extra query parameters on the authorization URL. A value given here replaces the default set. Standard OAuth parameters (response_type, client_id, redirect_uri, scope, state, code_challenge, code_challenge_method) cannot be set.

redirect_host.description: Host name in the redirect URI. The callback listens on 127.0.0.1 and ::1.

login_port.description: Port of the sign-in callback. 0 picks a free port; the issuer may only accept the registered one.

callback_path.description: Path of the loopback redirect URI.

copy_code_uri.description: Redirect URI of login --copy-code: a page that shows a code to paste into the terminal, for when the browser is on another machine.

login_timeout_ms.description: How long login waits for the browser redirect or the pasted code.

open_browser.description: Open the authorization URL in a browser. The --no-browser flag turns it off for one run. The URL is always printed.

expiry_margin_ms.description: How long before its stored expiry the access token counts as expired in status. Keep it equal to the adapter's upstream.expiry_margin_ms.

keep_backup.description: Keep the previous credential file as <auth_file>.bak (mode 0600) before each rewrite. One generation.
